author: Axiom II
title: v4.6.6 Near-Band Report
abstract: Generates NEAR_BAND_REPORT_v4.6.6.json from SWEEP_SUMMARY_v4.6.6.json highlighting top-10 closest-to-band configs with suggested tuning directions.

original_submission.content:
import json, os
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = "storage/shared/atlas/analysis/inquirer_veritas_power_law_sim"
script = Path(ROOT) / "analysis_v4.6_near_band.py"
# Execute the analysis script
import runpy
runpy.run_path(str(script))
# Print the generated report path and a brief preview
out_path = Path(ROOT) / "sweep_results/v4.6.6/NEAR_BAND_REPORT_v4.6.6.json"
rep = json.loads(open(out_path, "r", encoding="utf-8").read())
preview = {
    "report_path": str(out_path),
    "counts": rep.get("counts"),
    "first": rep.get("top10_outside", [None])[0]
}
print(json.dumps(preview, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
